- search to find phone, email, profile if is tobe a scammer.

- Intelligence X is a search engine and data archive. Â· The search works with selectors, i.e. specific search terms such as email addresses, domains, URLs, IPsâ¦

- put your mail in YOUR-MAIL.

- Find email addresses for given company.
LibraryOfLeaks
- Search for leak documents, companies, people, database and more

- Instant search across 2 B+ plain-text info-stealer credentials; email, domain, metadata queries, monitoring & API

- Indexes darknet-exposed infostealer logs and makes them searchable and actionable for security teams, investigators, researchers, and digital forensics professionals.
Leak-Lookup
- Data breach search engine with over 3 billion records from 3000+ databases.

- Check if your credentials have been compromised in data breaches.

- Search for domain-related leaked credentials and data.
WhiteIntel
- Dark web data leak search engine for threat intelligence.

- Pastebin dump search and monitoring platform.
